name: AI Recipe: App Prototype
description: Claude researches a current trend and builds a runnable single-page app prototype — README pitch, requirements, HTML/CSS/JS and sample data — with a concept-art cover. Opens from file://, no build step.

parameters.label: ai-automation-recipes clone
parameters.help: Absolute path to your local clone of ai-automation-tools/ai-automation-recipes.

parameters.label: Output folder
parameters.help: Root folder for all recipe output. Each recipe writes into its own collection under it.

parameters.label: Claude model
parameters.help: Claude model alias for the run.

parameters.label: Cover image engine
parameters.help: auto uses the first of GEMINI_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY that is set (add it as a task secret or in the clone's .env). none skips the cover.
